items.source: Utility to create SQL Segments. Typically used as entry point to the Statement Builder. Objects and dependent objects created by the Query AST are immutable except for builders.
items.translation: 用于创建 SQL Segment的工具。通常用作语句构建器的入口点。由查询抽象语法树（AST）创建的实体及其依赖对象是不可变的，除了构建器之外。
